# Expressions

Expressions are values you put into effects and conditions. 67 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Ago / later {#ago}

```carve
%timespan% ago
%timespan% later
time since %date%
time until %date%
```

A date relative to now, or the time since or until a date.

```carve
if time since {last::%uuid of player%} < 30 seconds:
    send "slow down" to player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [timespans](../syntax/timespans.md)

## Argument {#arg}

```carve
arg[ument]
arg-%number%
```

A command argument, counted from 1. Its type comes from the command line.

```carve
command /pay <player> <number>:
    trigger:
        send "Paying %arg-2% to %arg-1%"
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## Arithmetic {#math}

```carve
%number% (+|-|*|/) %number%
-%number%
(%number%)
```

Math with the usual order. Works on timespans and dates too. Dividing by zero is a runtime error.

```carve
set {_half} to (5 + 3) / 2
```

Since **0.1.0** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## Block {#block}

```carve
block at %location%
block (below|above) %location%
block (north|south|east|west) of %location%

%player%'s targeted block
```

A block position. `targeted block` looks up to 100 blocks.

```carve

```


## Chunk {#chunk_at}

```carve

```

A chunk value, or the list of chunks in a square radius (at most 32).

## Parse placeholders {#parse_placeholders}

```carve
parse placeholders in %text% [for %player%]
```

Replaces every `%name%` placeholder in the text. Write `%%name%%` in a script string, because `%%` is a literal percent sign there. Unknown placeholders stay as written.

```carve
send parse placeholders in "Hi %%player_name%%, %%server_online%% online" for player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w4-placeholders](../syntax/w4-placeholders.md)

## Parsed as number {#parsed_number}

```carve

```

The number in a text, or `<none>` if it isn't one.

```carve

```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [expressions](../syntax/expressions.md)

## Ping and IP {#ping}

```carve
ping of %player%
ip [address] of %player%
%player%'s ip
```

The player's ping in milliseconds, or their IP address.

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [op-kick-ban](../syntax/op-kick-ban.md)

## Placeholder {#placeholder}

```carve
placeholder %text% [for %player%]
```

Value of one placeholder (no percent signs), like `"player_name"`, `"server_online"`, `"carve_var_coins"` or one a script defines. The player defaults to the event's player. Unknown placeholders give `<none>`.

```carve
send placeholder "player_health" for player
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w4-placeholders](../syntax/w4-placeholders.md)

## Placeholder request values {#placeholder_request_values}

```carve
the identifier
the prefix
the result
```

Values inside `on placeholder request`. `the identifier` and `the prefix` are read only; `set the result to ...` answers the request.

```carve
on placeholder request for prefix "x":
    set the result to "you asked for %the identifier%"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w4-placeholders](../syntax/w4-placeholders.md)

## Ray trace {#ray_trace}

```carve
ray trace from %player|location% [in direction %vector%] [with max distance %number%] [including fluids] [ignoring blocks|entities|fluids]
hit (block|entity|block face|position|distance) of %ray%
```

Casts a thin ray and keeps the result in a variable. The hit is the nearer of the first block and the first entity. From a location, give a direction.

```carve
on join:
    set {_r} to ray trace from player with max distance 50
    send "you look at %hit block of {_r}%"
```

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [w4-skbee-raytrace-world](../syntax/w4-skbee-raytrace-world.md)
